output.summary: A shrub or small tree native to the Central American tropics and northern South America, although its exact origin is unknown. Its soft-spined red-brown pods expose seeds covered by waxy blood-red arils. The ground seeds provide annatto, an orange-red condiment and food coloring used widely in traditional dishes.
output.edibilityNote: Ground seeds are used as a spice or paste; heating them in oil or fat extracts color and subtle flavor for foods.
